summary:
I ran build attempt 7 (c2c381d) against this PC's live container layer store (1f35079a…) using the published exe. I took kernel pool-tag and System-handle marks between runs. The exe dates from 07:24, which is after every real source file (latest 07:13), and the tree matches c2c381d.

**What the previous send-back asked for**
- **Refusal through the share:** `\\localhost\C$\…\Files\Windows\Media` is now refused (EXIT 0, status Refused, 0 files).
- **More spellings, all refused with WC* +0:**
  - `\\127.0.0.1\C$`, `\\SHUBH_TUF24\C$`, `\\192.168.50.254\C$` and `\\0--1.ipv6-literal.net\C$`;
  - `\\?\UNC\localhost\C$` and `\\LOCALHOST\c$` in lower case;
  - `\\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolume5\…` and `\\?\Volume{GUID}\…`;
  - `\\.\C:\…`, forward slashes, a `..` segment, `\\?\` with a trailing separator;
  - the 8.3 name, a subst drive (Q:) and a junction from %TEMP%.
- **Scans above the store:** `C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Containers` and `\\localhost\C$\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Containers` both report skippedStores 1 and opensUnderExcludedStore 0, with WC* +0.
- **Q-186:** with the precaution off, the planted-store tests show the store counted and a root picked inside it scanned as picked. MainWindow passes its own set of switched-on precautions into every scan. X-005 shows the confirmation wording, which says every later scan can add more.

**One rise I could not explain.** During the first WindowCases X-006 run (8 s), WCsc rose by 13, WCfc and WCri by 11 each, and the System 0x120089 handles by 13. It did not happen again:
- a second X-006 run gave +0;
- the 25 later app runs on the same and other store spellings gave +0;
- the idle windows gave +0.

Between the builder's last marks and my first one, WCsc had already risen by 91 with no SL-095 run of mine in progress. So this could be ambient activity on the machine or the app's first listing of the folders beside the store; telling them apart needs elevated pool tracing.

**Suites and other checks**
- The repro passes (exit 0).
- The full suite has 537 passed and 3 failed. The 3 are the same last-access tests that already failed at afd021d, before this slice.
- PoolWatchCases All (including the C-052 rehearsal, RUN COMPLETE, scratch deleted) passed.
- WindowMutants All caught 11 of 11 mutants.
- WindowCases X-001 to X-006 and T-003 passed.
- rules-parity agrees; the rules harness gives 93/93 AS-RECORDED at engine 6cfb7ce; Fitness reports all 81 rules hold.

**What still stands before merge**
1. AA-015's approved architecture text still says a root inside the store is refused "whatever the settings say". That contradicts Q-186 and the code. Its approval cites a test that no longer exists. Raised against build-slice.
2. O-110, O-111, O-112 and O-113 are unfixed in the tree. Five orphaned rehearse-* folders now sit in C:\WINDOWS\TEMP\fsa-poolwatch, including a new one from 08:06.
3. O-002's precondition is false: the store holds real bytes, for example dotnet.bcf at 557,268 B. Q-180 and Q-181 already accepted this as the labelled "size not counted" row.

**Loop warning.** Build attempts 3, 4 and 5 were each sent back by code review on PoolWatch and changed no src; the person ended that loop by narrowing the criterion. O-110 to O-113 and AA-015 are the same kind of text and rig fixes. They should be done in one lap, with no further scanner work.

DONE (c) of the original report, and the tens-of-GB FMfn/NtfF/File growth, were narrowed out of this slice and moved to SC-128. They need the person's restart session.

criteria.criterion: 1. scan C: (a root above the container layer store) — when the planted store holds a nested tree (<id>\Files\Windows\... with files) plus Hives, Bindings and a dotnet.bcf file beside Files
criteria.how: AScanAboveTheStoreStopsAtItAndCountsEverythingElse passed in the full suite. On the real store, the published exe on C:\ and \\localhost\C$ ...\Containers completed with skippedStores=1, opensUnderExcludedStore=0 and WC* +0 (seq3 L1/L2, X-006 run 2). The repro passes (exit 0).

criteria.criterion: 2. pick a scan root — when the root is the store itself, or a folder inside it (Layers\<id>\Files\Windows)
criteria.how: ARootAtOrInsideTheStoreIsRefused passed. The real store refused as root (X-001 inside X-006), and Layers\<id>\Files\Windows\Media through the exe was refused with 0 files and WC* +0.

criteria.criterion: 3. pick a scan root — when the store spelled another way: a \\?\ prefix, a trailing separator, different letter case
criteria.how: ARootInsideTheStoreInAnotherSpellingIsRefusedWithNoOpen passed. On the real store, D7 (\\?\C:\…\Media\), D6 (\\LOCALHOST\c$ in lower case), D1 (\\.\C:\) and D2 (forward slashes) were all refused with WC* +0.

criteria.criterion: 4. pick a scan root — when the root reaches the store through a junction, a subst drive (DefineDosDevice, unelevated) or an 8.3 short name
criteria.how: ARootThroughAJunctionIntoTheStoreIsRefused passed on the planted store. On the real store, a junction from %TEMP%, subst Q:, the 8.3 name C:\PROGRA~3\…\1F3507~1\…, the volume GUID and GLOBALROOT roots were all refused with WC* +0.

criteria.criterion: 5. scan C: — when siblings named 'Layers.', 'Layers ' and 'Layers2', and a 'Layers' folder elsewhere in the tree
criteria.how: FoldersNamedLikeTheStoreElsewhereOrBesideItAreCounted and SiblingsNamedLayersDotAndLayersSpaceAreCounted passed (planted, created through \\?\). A root spelled with the Win32 form 'Layers.\<id>' is refused; that is correct, because Win32 strips the dot and the path names the store.

criteria.criterion: 6. scan C: — when no container store exists (Windows 10 or a PC without containers; the override points at an absent folder)
criteria.how: WithNoStoreTheScanIsWhatItWasBefore and AnEmptyKnownFolderMeansNoStoreNeverEveryPath passed, using an absent planted store. No Windows 10 PC or PC without containers was reached.

criteria.criterion: 7. scan with the protection turned off — when the wcifs-layer-store workaround is off, over a planted store and a picked root inside it
criteria.how: WithThePrecautionOffTheStoreIsListedAndCountedLikeAnyFolder passed: off counts OutsideBytes+StoreBytes, with no skipped store and no backstop refusal. WithThePrecautionOffARootAtOrInsideTheStoreIsScannedAsPicked passed 3 of 3 rows: on gives Refused, off gives Completed with the entries counted, and Resolve with off is None on a cancelled token. MainWindow passes the session's set of switched-on precautions to Scanner.Scan. This was not run on the real store, deliberately.

criteria.criterion: 8. show why a result is different — when a C: scan whose store was skipped, and a pick that was refused
criteria.how: X-006 passed twice. The refused root's OutcomeTitle reads 'Not scanned: …' and its OutcomeDetail names wcifs.sys and the Settings checkbox. The skipped store's OutcomeNotes reads 'Not scanned, size not counted… can be turned off in Settings', and the tab header counts it apart. X-002 and X-004 passed.

criteria.criterion: 9. turn the protection off — when the user unticks the checkbox and answers No, then unticks and answers Yes
criteria.how: X-005 passed. The logged question states that a folder inside the store is scanned as picked and leaks for each entry until a restart, and that later scans can add more. Answering Yes gives 'Settings (1 off)...'.

criteria.criterion: 10. run the pool protocol end to end — when PoolWatch.ps1 -Protocol -Rehearse over a generated %TEMP% tree
criteria.how: PoolWatchCases C-052 passed: RUN COMPLETE, 'REHEARSAL scratch deleted: True'.

criteria.criterion: 11. check a pool run for completeness — when an exe-full arm exited 70 with a null report
12. check a pool run for completeness — when arms.jsonl lacks arms the plan line names, including a run with no exe-full or exe-cancel/close arms at all

13. check a pool run for completeness — when a cancel or close arm whose hook refused (the app shut down before the trigger, or the trigger deadline passed and the scan finished with status Completed)
14. check a pool run for completeness — when an arm with its /settled mark missing, or stopped by the machine guard while a later arm started already over it

obligations.evidence: The precondition is false: the store holds real bytes. Layers\1f35079a-…\dotnet.bcf is 557,268 B, and O-015 records the Files tree holding pristine copies of about 500 MB. Those bytes leave every C: total. Q-180 and Q-181 (person decisions) already accept this as an honest, labelled shortfall, and the exe shows it as 'Not scanned, size not counted' (X-006). Nothing needs building. The obligation should be closed by those decisions, not treated as a defect.

On this PC: links are never followed, and a file with a second name inside the store is charged once outside it (AFileWithASecondNameInsideTheStoreIsChargedOnceOutsideIt passed). Every root spelling I could reach maps onto the store and is refused or skipped, with opensUnderExcludedStore=0 and WC* +0: 17 inside-store spellings, plus the C:\ and \\localhost\C$ roots above the store. No share anyone created covers the store or a folder above it (shares are ADMIN$=C:\WINDOWS, C$, D$, IPC$). There is no Docker windowsfilter folder, and no Sandbox is running. Documented gaps with no instance on this PC: such a share, other WCI stores, and a drive letter mapped with net use to \\localhost\C$ (not created, because it changes network settings).

The real store was refused through the published exe in 17 spellings, with WC* +0 and 0x120089 +0 after each run: \\localhost\C$, \\127.0.0.1\C$, \\SHUBH_TUF24\C$, \\192.168.50.254\C$, \\0--1.ipv6-literal.net\C$, \\?\UNC\localhost\C$, \\LOCALHOST\c$ in lower case, \\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolume5, \\?\Volume{GUID}, \\.\C:, forward slashes, a '..' segment, \\?\ with a trailing separator, Layers.\, 8.3, subst Q: and a junction. Not tried: a hosts-file or DNS alias, and a net use drive letter. Both change system or network settings.

not_reached: The person-run PoolWatch session (-Prepare, Start > Restart, -Protocol) with real 5 full and 5 cancelled C: scans. DONE (c) of the original report rests on it, and it was moved to SC-128 when the person narrowed the criterion.
A whole-drive C: scan by the published exe with the fix on this PC. Whole-drive scans are for the person to run; spike #87's cold listing-only walk alone reached +537 MB.

What caused the WCsc +13, WCfc/WCri +11 and 0x120089 +13 inside the first X-006 run's 8 s window. It did not recur in a second X-006 run or in 25 later app runs. Telling ambient wcifs activity (the CmService zygote or other sessions) from a first listing of Containers' siblings needs elevated pool tracing (WPR/ETW) or poolmon, and neither is on the elevation list.
`fltmc filters` on C:. It needs an administrator, and no named elevation operation runs it.

Root spellings that need system or network changes: a drive letter mapped with net use to \\localhost\C$, a hosts-file or DNS alias of this PC, and a share someone created over ProgramData or a folder below it.
Other live WCI stores, such as a running Windows Sandbox or Docker windowsfilter. Neither exists on this PC.
Windows 10, or a PC without containers. Criterion 6 was checked only with an absent planted store.
The precaution-off path on the real store. It is forbidden on purpose because it leaks until a restart, so it was checked on planted stores only.

The tens-of-GB growth itself: FMfn, NtfF and File retention with the store excluded (spike #87, outcome C), which belongs to SC-128. A data point for that work: my session's suites and rehearsal left FMfn +25,639 live.
